data.content: # Predicted line-ups for Premier League teams in Matchweek 7. Football writer Ben Bloom has predicted how Premier League clubs will line up this weekend. ##### Everton v Chelsea predicted line-ups. **Everton:** Jarrad Branthwaite is a doubt for this after picking up a knock last weekend, but Vitalii Mykolenko has “got a chance” to return having missed that match. Brennan Johnson has started the last four Premier League games on the right, but Tyrique George continues to provide David Moyes with an alternative there if he wants it. Andoni Iraola suggested he will “leave the chance open” for their return here, but that he will “have to wait and see”. Should Szoboszlai not make it, Trey Nyoni could retain his spot in central midfield, while Lewis Koumas will hope to lead the line if neither Isak nor Gakpo are fit. He may well be fit to return here, but Ryan Sessegnon impressed in his absence so will hope to retain his spot.
